subject.title: fix(github-copilot): prevent stale encrypted reasoning failures

question: Should this PR become the canonical combined Copilot sanitation and managed-transport recovery change while `streamSimple` recovery lands separately, or should the generic recovery be consolidated into one shared implementation before merge?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but current code has multiple Responses lifecycles and several overlapping PRs; choosing the permanent owner boundary and landing order requires repository-owner intent rather than an automated repair.

options.title: Coordinate both lifecycles
options.body: Use this PR for Copilot sanitation, consolidate or explicitly pair its recovery with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108462, and refresh proof on the final combined heads before closing the canonical issue.

options.title: Land this scoped fix first
options.body: Merge this PR for the proven Copilot and managed-transport path, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95441 open, and land the `streamSimple` sibling separately before declaring full resolution.

options.title: Prefer narrower replacements
options.body: Select the narrower provider and recovery PRs as canonical and close this PR only after those replacements are mergeable, proof-positive, and collectively cover the same behavior.

recommendation.title: Coordinate both lifecycles
recommendation.body: Use this PR for Copilot sanitation, consolidate or explicitly pair its recovery with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108462, and refresh proof on the final combined heads before closing the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history ownership signal is the recent Responses lifecycle hardening in commit 4617728, which directly affects the boundary that must be chosen.
